title: Aromatic Amber Filipino Banana Pudding
description: A creamy and aromatic dessert featuring bananas, with a soffritto base and low glycemic friendly ingredients, perfect for a lazy Sunday, served on a slate tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, prepare the soffritto base by sauteing the sliced bananas in melted butter until caramelized.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, almond flour, granulated sweetener, eggs, vanilla extract, and salt.
Add the soffritto base to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Pour the mixture into individual ramekins or a large baking dish.
Place the ramekins or baking dish on a slate tile vessel.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the pudding is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
